---
title: "About R+AI"
---

R+AI 2026 is an R Consortium event focused on artificial intelligence with R. The program included keynotes, talks, workshops, and community discussions.

## Goals

- Showcase practical AI with R across industries.
- Share advances in modeling, large language models, and responsible AI.
- Connect the community through hands-on learning.

## Quick Facts

**Dates:** November 10-11, 2026  
**Location:** 100% online  
**CFP:** Closed  
**Community:** Speakers participated in live Q&A  
**Recordings:** Talks were recorded and will be posted to the [R Consortium YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@RConsortium)  
**Time Zone:** Schedule is US Eastern Time Zone
